```app
// Snake: arrows or the buttons steer; eat the food; walls and your tail end it. Best score is kept.
state cells = [0; 300];   // 20 x 15 squares
state xs = [0; 0];        // the body, head last
state ys = [0; 0];
state dx = 1;
state dy = 0;
state fx = 0;
state fy = 0;
state over = false;
saved state best = 0;

fn at(x: int, y: int) -> int { return y * 20 + x; }

fn turnH(d: int) { if dy != 0 { dx = d; dy = 0; } }
fn turnV(d: int) { if dx != 0 { dy = d; dx = 0; } }

fn paint() {
  for i in 0..len(cells) { cells[i] = 0; }
  for i in 0..len(xs) { cells[at(xs[i], ys[i])] = 2; }
  cells[at(fx, fy)] = 1;
}

fn dropFood() {
  let freex = [0; 0];
  let freey = [0; 0];
  for y in 0..15 {
    for x in 0..20 {
      if cells[at(x, y)] == 0 { push(freex, x); push(freey, y); }
    }
  }
  if len(freex) > 0 {
    let p = random(len(freex));
    fx = freex[p];
    fy = freey[p];
  }
}

fn start() {
  clear(xs);
  clear(ys);
  for i in 3..6 { push(xs, i); push(ys, 7); }
  dx = 1;
  dy = 0;
  over = false;
  paint();
  dropFood();
}

every 150 {
  if !over && len(xs) > 0 {
    let hx = xs[len(xs) - 1] + dx;
    let hy = ys[len(ys) - 1] + dy;
    if hx < 0 || hx >= 20 || hy < 0 || hy >= 15 || cells[at(hx, hy)] == 2 {
      over = true;
      best = max(best, len(xs) - 3);
    } else {
      push(xs, hx);
      push(ys, hy);
      if hx == fx && hy == fy {
        dropFood();
      } else {
        remove(xs, 0);
        remove(ys, 0);
      }
      paint();
    }
  }
}

on key "left" { turnH(-1); }
on key "right" { turnH(1); }
on key "up" { turnV(-1); }
on key "down" { turnV(1); }

label "Snake";
label "Length " + len(xs) + "   Best " + best;
grid 20, cells;
row {
  button "Left" { turnH(-1); }
  button "Up" { turnV(-1); }
  button "Down" { turnV(1); }
  button "Right" { turnH(1); }
}
if over || len(xs) == 0 {
  if over { label "Game over"; }
  button "Start" { start(); }
}
```
